defects.finding_key: packages/backend/src/datasource/datasource.service.ts::partial/inconsistent fix for value fidelity: only date/timestamp/timestamptz are pinned to raw postgres text, while other pg types that the default parser turns into js objects still flow through and end up json-stringified into sheet cells. the change's own e2e expectations enshrine this: bytea renders as `{"type":"buffer","data":[222,173,190,239]}`, interval as `{"years":1,"months":2,"days":3}`, circle as `{"x":1,"y":2,"radius":3}`. if the intent is "cells show the value the database shows", these are user-visible wrong values left unaddressed; if the intent is only the timezone shift, the accepted json-blob rendering should be a stated decision (in the design doc) rather than an incidental test expectation.
defects.summary: Partial/inconsistent fix for value fidelity: only DATE/TIMESTAMP/TIMESTAMPTZ are pinned to raw Postgres text, while other pg types that the default parser turns into JS objects still flow through and end up JSON-stringified into sheet cells. The change's own e2e expectations enshrine this: BYTEA renders as `{"type":"Buffer","data":[222,173,190,239]}`, INTERVAL as `{"years":1,"months":2,"days":3}`, CIRCLE as `{"x":1,"y":2,"radius":3}`. If the intent is "cells show the value the database shows", these are user-visible wrong values left unaddressed; if the intent is only the timezone shift, the accepted JSON-blob rendering should be a stated decision (in the design doc) rather than an incidental test expectation.
